$comment: languages-world-1 (10 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for SERBIAN, Latin script (sr-RS): alerg (alergija, alergičan), (ne)tolerancija, osetljiv, celijakija, anafilaksa, bez <allergen> (bez glutena, bez laktoze, bez mleka…), bezglutensk / bezlaktozn, ne sadrži / nema glutena, bezbedno / sigurno / pogodno za, može da sadrži, tragovi, (unakrsna) kontaminacija. š č ć ž fold away on both sides ("bez glutena" = "bez glutena", "alergican" = "alergičan"); a small Cyrillic set is added for customers who type in Cyrillic. Bare bez is NOT a stem; posno (Orthodox fasting food) is a dietary choice, not a free-from safety word, and is left out. OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
